picks.editorial_note: A decade-long Berkeley Lab/NASA collaboration achieved real-time X-ray imaging of spacecraft heat shields ablating under extreme heat, fused with AI-trained models — a genuine scientific advance with direct implications for spacecraft safety.
picks.title: Scientists Get Real-Time Look Inside Spacecraft Heat Shields During Extreme Heat Conditions

picks.editorial_note: Syracuse's new cross-school Institute for Artificial Intelligence signals a major institutional bet on AI, uniting four schools for research and industry/government partnerships rather than a single lab or grant.
picks.title: Syracuse University Launches Institute for Artificial Intelligence

picks.editorial_note: UCF and Sage Bionetworks used AI to screen 200 FDA-approved drugs down to 10 (three especially promising) repurposing candidates for a rare pediatric nerve tumor — a concrete step toward real-world treatment options for a hard-to-treat condition.
picks.title: UCF Researcher Identifies 10 Potential Treatments for Rare Nerve Tumor in Children
